instances.claim: This tells me that the value of a Cent is no longer fixed to the object and is instead endlessly re-decided — and then tells me so twice more in other words.
instances.why: Line 15 has already established redefinition by collective consensus; 16 states it as mechanism (value decoupled from object, carried by social consensus), but 17 only re-labels that same state as 'indeterminate and continually redefined' and 18 only re-attributes it as 'an ongoing process of redefinition'. Neither 17 nor 18 moves to the object, the audience, or the form — they are the same register and nearly the same vocabulary ('redefined', 'redefinition'), so cutting them loses no point; keep 16.
